{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the dataframe
print(trial_df.info())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values per column:\n', trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:', trial_df.duplicated().sum())

# Look at the unique values in key columns
print('\nUnique values in arm:', trial_df['arm'].unique())
print('Unique values in severity:', trial_df['severity'].unique())
print('Unique values in response:', trial_df['response'].unique())"}
